description: This file is a shell script used for testing the rename detection features in the diff engine, particularly in a Git context. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and assertions for verifying how rename detection behaves under various scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A helper method to define a test case expecting success, runs the provided shell commands and verifies they succeed.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the generated diff patch against expected output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Outputs specified lines to a file for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock to simulate time passage in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the testing script, often to finalize or cleanup.
